confirm_writes_on_prod.description: The first write of a session on a connection labelled prod asks first.

continue_on_error.description: Run all (F8) keeps going after a statement fails, instead of stopping.

enabled.description: Record the statements run, per connection.

ephemeral_to_disk.description: Write the scratch database's history to disk too, instead of only keeping it for the run.

max_entries.description: The most history entries one connection keeps.

redact.description: Words whose string literal is stored as '•••' in the history, such as PASSWORD.

keybindings.description: Per context, a key (such as <ctrl-enter>) mapped to an action name, or to null to unbind it. See keybindings.md.

max_rows.description: The most rows a query keeps; more are not read. 0 keeps every row.

theme.description: The colour theme; --theme wins over it. Only dark exists for now.
